lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical column of four high-intensity circular spots is visible in the mid-lateral field, with secondary clusters forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-anterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridge lines, forming anchor nodes occupied by high-luminance circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges traverse the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to shadowed ventral troughs.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of white, linear dermal striations is visible on the dorsal-lateral surface anterior to the dorsal fin base, indicating superficial tissue scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras are visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface and trailing the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
